name: title-6
text: Exemplo de Dockerfile
textPreview: Exemplo de Dockerfile

name: dockerfile-code
text:
FROM python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

EXPOSE 5050
CMD ["gunicorn", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:5050", "main:app"]
textPreview: FROM python:3.12-slim |  | WORKDIR /app |  | COPY requirements.txt . | RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt |  | COPY . . |...

name: dockerfile-notes
text:
O build cria a imagem
RUN acontece durante o build
CMD acontece quando o container inicia
EXPOSE não publica a porta no computador
